_notes: The game clock and its events, recorded by running UQM 0.8.0's own clock.c (InitGameClock, GameClockTick, MoveGameClockDays, AddEvent, processClockDayEvents) and gameev.c (AddInitialGameEvents, EventHandler) in the recording program tools/extract/golden/clock.c. Code only, no content. A new game is starcon.c's: InitGameStructures (globdata.c, so avail_race_q is UQM's own, made from each ship's RACE_DESC by master.c's LoadMasterShipList and load_ship; the graphics, strings and state files stubbed), InitGameClock and AddInitialGameEvents. check_race_growth (gameev.c) runs on the fleets each day; check_hyperspace_encounter is only counted. SetRaceDest (gameev.c) and StartSphereTracking (build.c) are UQM's own.

Each scenario: its commands (new: a new game; day N: N days of GameClockTick; move N: MoveGameClockDays (N); hyper 0|1: the flagship out of or in hyperspace; rampdown: what slyhome.c does when told of the self-destruct code; dest R X Y D F: SetRaceDest (R, X, Y, D, F), race R (races.h's *_SHIP number) heading for (X, Y) D days away, to run event F there (255 none); growth R G F E: race R's growth, growth_fract and growth_err_term set, as 3c's events set them; track R: StartSphereTracking (R); system S: the flagship in interplanetary flight in the system whose generator is gendef.h's S (CurStarDescPtr's Index; 0 none), as the location gates read it; add R M D Y E: AddEvent (R ? RELATIVE_EVENT : ABSOLUTE_EVENT, M, D, Y, E), as a talk queues an event; strength R N: race R's actual_strength N; ally R F: SetRaceAllied (R, F); crew B C: CREW_PURCHASED0 and 1 the crew bought B, CrewCost C; distress N: ZOQFOT_DISTRESS N; state F N: the mission field F N, as a talk sets it) and its steps: one after new, rampdown, track and add, one each day of day, one for the whole of move.

A step: [[year, month, day] after it, [[event, depth, year, month, day]...] each event EventHandler ran, in order, depth 0 for those clock.c ran (from the queue's head, or AddEvent's due at once) and more for one run at once from within another, with the date it ran on, check_hyperspace_encounter's calls, SLYLANDRO_MULTIPLIER after, [[event, year, month, day]...] the queue after, [[race, allied_state, actual_strength, known_strength, loc.x, loc.y, known_loc.x, known_loc.y, growth, growth_fract, growth_err_term, days_left, func_index, dest_loc.x, dest_loc.y]...] the fleets (FLEET_INFO in avail_race_q) that changed since the step before (every race's after new), [ARILOU_SPACE, ARILOU_CHECKED_UMGAH, ZOQFOT_DISTRESS, SPATHI_SHIELDED_SELVES, CREW_PURCHASED0, CREW_PURCHASED1, CrewCost, PKUNK_MISSION, PKUNK_ON_THE_MOVE, PKUNK_SWITCH, YEHAT_ABSORBED_PKUNK, THRADD_MISSION, ILWRATH_FIGHT_THRADDASH, HELIX_UNPROTECTED, THRADD_VISITS, MYCON_KNOW_AMBUSH, UTWIG_SUPOX_MISSION, UTWIG_VISITS, UTWIG_INFO, SUPOX_VISITS, SUPOX_INFO, UTWIG_WAR_NEWS, SUPOX_WAR_NEWS] after it], and after track one more: StartSphereTracking's result. Events are gameev.h's numbers (data/events.json), races races.h's (data/races.json's order). An event a fleet's arrival runs (gameev.c's own EventHandler call) isn't listed, only what it does.
